source: local built flop-lab MCP server: tools/list

tools.name: lab_verify_channel
tools.description: Cross-check a compute channel. Recorded mode accepts the bundled channel only.

tools.name: lab_verify_tape
tools.description: Check exact escrow arithmetic in a bounded settlement page.

tools.name: lab_score_rank
tools.description: Rank observed miner evidence. Recorded mode evaluates at capture time.

tools.name: lab_score_route
tools.description: Select an eligible miner without sending inference. A live price ceiling fails closed if the quote is unknown.

tools.name: lab_spendguard_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate supplied policy, reservation history and request locally. No ledger writes or spending.

tools.name: lab_harness_run
tools.description: Run the bounded read-only gateway contract claim. Hard spending ceiling is zero.

tools.name: lab_challenger_watch
tools.description: Take one bounded challenge-review snapshot. Does not start a daemon or submit challenges.

tools.name: lab_spec_diff
tools.description: Compare the pinned paper with observed protocol catalog and transactions.

tools.name: lab_mcp_audit
tools.description: Audit the hosted knowledge tool against its own advertised schemas with a bounded request budget.

tools.name: lab_explorer_lookup
tools.description: Look up a block, hash or address with exact identifier matching. Recorded mode only returns its captured input.

tools.name: lab_indexer_audit
tools.description: Audit bounded block links, counters and settlement splits. Recorded mode uses the capture's fixed sample.

tools.name: lab_did_trail
tools.description: Verify the bundled public DID trail and signed artifacts. This operation is recorded-only.

tools.name: lab_doctor
tools.description: Read local operator readiness. Offline only, no port binding and no caller-selected paths.
